title.en: The Legend of the Condor Heroes

review.en: Guo Jing, a slow, honest boy raised on the Mongolian steppe, grows into a hero amid the wars of the Song, Jin and Mongols. Jin Yong's first great success mixes martial-arts adventure with history, comedy and a memorable heroine in Huang Rong. Judged as wuxia, it is a classic of the form, and the start of a famous trilogy.
review.zh: 在蒙古草原长大的郭靖，憨厚老实，在宋、金、蒙古的战乱中成长为大侠。金庸第一部大获成功的作品，把武侠冒险与历史、喜剧糅在一起，黄蓉更是令人难忘。放在武侠小说里看，它是经典，也是“射雕三部曲”的开端。
